request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change only the hammers at the bottom: erase the bottom left and the bottom right black hammer blocks with their arms, and draw one single big square soot-black iron hammer head on a short copper arm at the front centre of the copper band, between where they were. The machine then has exactly three hammers: top left, top right and front centre. Also erase the thin pale ring lines around the machine. Keep the body, copper band, key, lamp, steam, wheel, black outline and style the same.
